labels.com.docker.extension.detailed-descriptio:
Warp is a modern, reimagined terminal with AI built-in so you and your team can build great software, faster. It is currently available for MacOS.

Use the Warp extension for Docker to make opening Docker containers on the command line easier and more convenient.

Configure a user and preferred shell type. Warp supports bash, zsh, and fish.

Once your subshell is open you can enjoy Warp features as you’d expect, including block navigation, mouse and cursor editing, autocompletions, and AI command suggestions.

labels.name: Vault
labels.summary: Vault is a tool for securely accessing secrets.
labels.description: Vault is a tool for securely accessing secrets. A secret is anything that you want to tightly control access to, such as API keys, passwords, certificates, and more. Vault provides a unified interface to any secret, while providing tight access control and recording a detailed audit log.
